title: Building a Extraction RPG
author: Enjoyooooor
selftext:
I wanted to mix what I like about extraction shooters with the depth of an RPG. You load into a raid, gather what you can and try to get out alive. Between raids you’re building up your stash, crafting, trading, and figuring out what gear is worth risking on the next run.

i also want to build toward a player-driven economy where the stuff people bring back from raids matters. maybe you find a material you don’t need for your own gear, but someone else is looking for it to finish a craft. i like the idea of that giving you a reason to grab something you’d normally walk past.

  
Workflow includes : Claude , Codex, Tripo , Meshy, Suno, ElevenLabs

Curious how other here are using these tools. What’s one part of your workflow where AI actually saves you time/tokens?
